scripts.deps: mkdir -p /tmp/pnpm-store && pnpm config set store-dir /tmp/pnpm-store &&rm -rf node_modules && rm -rf pnpm-lock.yaml && rm -rf ~/.pnpm-store && pnpm store prune && pnpm install --no-prefer-frozen-lockfile
scripts.check: vp fmt --check && vp run -r check && pnpm lint
scripts.lint:actions:syntax: sh -c 'if command -v actionlint >/dev/null; then actionlint -ignore "unexpected key .queue. for .concurrency."; elif [ -n "$LINT_ACTIONS_REQUIRED" ]; then echo "actionlint is not installed"; exit 1; else echo "actionlint is not installed (pipx install actionlint-py); the Lint workflow runs it"; fi'
scripts.lint:actions:security: sh -c 'if command -v zizmor >/dev/null; then zizmor .github/workflows; elif [ -n "$LINT_ACTIONS_REQUIRED" ]; then echo "zizmor is not installed"; exit 1; else echo "zizmor is not installed (pipx install zizmor); the Lint workflow runs it"; fi'
